svg.text: Offboard intentionally and preserve basic protection
Teaching diagram · not a screenshot or actual terminal result
Defender portal, Azure Arc machine and local console
Follow current Microsoft offboarding guidance for the actual onboarding method and portal
experience. Verify whether automatic offboarding applies; do not assume a saved Off switch
instantly removes installed agents or every tenant association.
If retiring the lab connection, use the documented Arc disconnect procedure on the correct
server after reviewing its extensions and dependencies, then reconcile the cloud resource. Do
not just delete a portal record and assume the local agent or protection is gone.
Keep required local Antivirus/firewall active, and keep Wazuh if that is your continuing
monitoring path. Historical portal records may remain; verify actual sensor state and billing
Check: The intended lab agents/connections have a documented end state without disabling
